sections.title: Data-Driven Decisions for Equity Partners
sections.body: We believe that informed investors are the best partners. Our interactive ROI calculator is designed to provide you with an immediate, high-level understanding of the project's financial mechanics. By adjusting variables such as the investment amount, the projected average utilization rate, and the exit multiple, you can see how the Kenya AI Compute model generates superior returns compared to traditional real estate or grid-bound data center assets. The tool uses our real-world OPEX projections and locked-in $0.04/kWh energy rate as its baseline, ensuring that your simulations are grounded in our technical reality. This is the same logic used in our internal 10-year financial model, now simplified for your primary evaluation. Additional context: the project follows a clear rollout roadmap that aligns low-cost energy, infrastructure reliability, and flexible deployment models.
